headline: The valkyrie replays: all 10 store sessions now verify, and the phone can't hide a dead mic
lede: Jon's first graded takes raised two blockers on PLAICRAFT S1. Both are closed: the stored valkyrie take replay-verifies full-run exactly as recorded, and the recorder now catches the iOS/Android freeze that silently ate a whole take's audio.

notes.text: Replay rebuilds the partner the live game chose — an absent stamp now means the sim's own default (valkyrie), not the export's historical elf. 10/10 store sessions replay-verified, 100%.

Capture guard: a device clock frozen >1 s is burned — the trace keeps wall pace, resume is asked, the badge drops off REC, and short bytes fail grading by name instead of hiding internally-consistent.

QA's default change quietly put 4 gauntlet golden traces red ON MAIN — the native-port spec was recorded beside elf and the CI scope missed it. The spec table (duplicated in two files) now pins its pairing explicitly, 89/89 green.
S1's remaining acceptance line is one fresh phone take graded green on replay+voice+clap — take the clap test at /retrogames/claptest and the grade posts itself.

look.text: Gauntlet — pick Valkyrie, the replay lane is honest now
